name: ocui
description: Manage multiple OpenCode sessions and projects from a single web interface over local or SSH connections.

paragraphs: ocui is a tool for developers who want to manage AI coding sessions from one spot. You can run and monitor projects across different folders or remote servers using a single web dashboard. It features live status tracking, built-in chat, terminal access, and a clear usage dashboard. This software runs as one small file on your computer.
features: This software handles the hard parts of managing AI tools so you can focus on code.
Single Binary: You only deal with one file. No installation or configuration scripts exist.
Session Management: Keep multiple coding tasks organized. Switch between local projects and remote servers without changing your workspace.
Embedded Tools: The interface includes a full terminal emulator. You do not need secondary programs to manage your files.
Secure Access: The tool uses local networking to keep your data on your machine. You can add a tunnel if you need to reach it from outside your home, but by default, it stays private.
